Deficiency_Details: All 1,000 patients, 12,000 tiles, and 16,012 observations are mathematically synthesized.
Models have only been tested on the in-distribution locked synthetic test split.
No whole-slide images from different pathology departments, slide preparation protocols, or scanner models.
No independent clinical biobank validation (e.g. NSCLC cohorts from public consortia or institutional repositories).
Zero real-time prospective patient enrollment, monitoring, or longitudinal outcome tracking.
Synthetic progression labels are mathematical thresholds (mean delta > 0.15), not RECIST 1.1 radiologist-reviewed progression.
No board-certified thoracic oncologists or pathologists have reviewed the ground truth or model outputs.
Model confidence is uncalibrated; softmax outputs are near 1.0 due to artificial procedural separability.
No real patient demographic, ancestry, comorbidity, or mutational subtype metadata available.
Software traps invalid inputs; however, clinical failure mode consequences (false positives/negatives) have not been audited in clinical trials.
Simulated stress tests performed; real clinical assay dropouts and histological mimics (e.g. granulomas, atypical adenomatous hyperplasia) not tested.
Dashboard provides manual review capabilities; formal human-in-the-loop override protocols and audit logs are not connected to hospital systems.
No DICOM / WSI format ingestion, no HL7 / FHIR EHR interoperability, no PACS integration.
No FDA 510(k), De Novo, or CE-IVDR premarket documentation, design history files, or risk management files (ISO 14971).
